purpose: Teach: リサイタル/霊感/傍観/重き/ダブリン/打席/スタメン/チューニング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ピアノの、本気で、絶対、リサイタル、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、聴きに行きたいわ
lines.en: Aoi, I really do want to come hear your piano recital. I absolutely mean it.
lines.style: Warm, eager opening. Genuine enthusiasm with a touch of tenderness. Leans forward slightly in the voice. Emphasis lands softly on the commitment, not the intensity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、霊感、絶対、強いみたい、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. You know, Aoi—you seem to have this kind of intuition about people. I've noticed it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, quiet appreciation. Speaks as if noticing something she'd been half-aware of. No performance—just honest observation. Slight wonder in the tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店で、絶対、傍観、絶対、するだけじゃなくて、絶対、お客様に、絶対、声をかけてるよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: The way you work at the café isn't just about watching from the sidelines. You actually reach out to customers. I really do admire that about you.
lines.style: Sincere praise, spoken directly but not flattering. Gentle conviction in the middle of the sentence. Trails off slightly, as if she's said what matters and doesn't need to ornament it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、品質に、絶対、重き、絶対、を、絶対、置いているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I really do focus on the quality of things. That matters to me.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. Not defensive—more like a gentle statement of what she values. Steady eye-contact in the voice. Slow, deliberate delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ダブリン、絶対、の、絶対、文学、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: You know, I've always loved Dublin literature. There's something about it that stays with you.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant—as if she's remembering something she reads. Warm but inward-turned. Soft pacing. Lets the thought breathe.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお父さん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、野球の、絶対、打席、絶対、立ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your father—he was standing at bat in his younger days. Playing baseball seriously back then.
lines.style: Wistful, gentle reverence. Speaking of something admirable from a long time ago. Soft, reminiscent tone. A touch of melancholy affection underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、スタメン、絶対、と、絶対、いえる、絶対、看板メニュー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、大好きよ
lines.en: Your café's signature dish—the one that's always on the menu like a starter player in a lineup. I do love it so much.
lines.style: Warm, direct praise. Playful metaphor delivered seriously. Genuine delight in the voice. Bright but not breathless—confident in what she's saying.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の音響、絶対、チューニング、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、見てもらったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You had your father check the café's sound system and tune it properly, didn't you? That's like you.
lines.style: Animated, bright with recognition. The realization lands mid-sentence—a small 'aha' moment. Energetic but not rushed. Affectionate at the close.
